newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end higher after sharp fall in Tokyo stocks.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end higher after sharp fall in Tokyo stocks.

text.p: Key March Japanese government bond (JGB) futures ended Monday's Tokyo session having made handsome gains following the plunge in Tokyo stocks.
The March closed up 0.50 at 126.25. It touched an intraday high of 126.32 after the Nikkei average of 225 leading shares plunged more than 800 points in the afternoon.
The key contract gave up some gains after the stock index erased some of its losses, traders said.
The Nikkei closed down 609.70 points, or 3.37 percent, at 17,480.34.
The volume of the March JGB futures was 49,891 contracts.
"Activity was led by dealers watching stock price moves and doing day trades," said a trader at a trust bank's securities unit.
"People bought JGB futures when stocks fell and took profit when stocks showed some recovery," said a brokerage house trader.
In the cash market, both profit-taking selling and bargain-hunting buying were detected, traders said.
Remarks by Bank of Japan (BOJ) Governor Yasuo Matsushita, Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto, and Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka, had little impact on the market, traders said.
